## Pipeline (one composite; each stage many-in, one-out)

| stage | in | out | owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ingest | Corpus | DomainGraph | Products |
| Encode | DomainGraph | Spec | Products |
| Validate | Spec | ValidSpec | Core |
| Analyze | ValidSpec, CorePolicy, Boundary | Outcome | Core |
| Certify | Outcome | Cert | Products |
| Circulate | ValidSpec | Circ | Products |
| Quantize | Outcome, Circ, DomainPolicy | Evidence | Products |
| Classify | Cert, Evidence | Verdict | Products |
| Attribute | Outcome, DomainGraph, Verdict, Circ | Finding | Products |
| Judge | Finding, Cert | TsVerdict | Products |
| Join | TsVerdict, TsVerdict | TsVerdict | Products |
| Bind | TsVerdict, Manifest, Finding | Receipt | Products |
| Explain | Finding | Explanation | Products |
| Diff | Finding, Finding | Delta | Products |
| Fill | Finding, DomainGraph | DomainGraph | Products |

## L0 Global

| id | where | tier | law | derives from | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| G0 | root | Types | Core invariance: crates/**, Cargo.lock, Cargo.toml and rust-toolchain.toml are byte-identical to the pinned manifest before every run; no product law is discharged by editing the core. | S.bind.manifest, I.analyze.pin | products/gates/core.sha256, products/gates/g0_invariance.sh |
| G1 | root | Property | Claim soundness: a receipt other than BLOCKED is issued only when the core produced a Report (no CoreError), the run is certified (spectral, Hodge and extension converged, cut consistent, not ambiguous, relative H0 computed when a boundary was given, report well-formed), and the policy floor is cleared. | S.certify.wf, A.certify.converged, A.certify.cut, A.certify.unique-null, A.classify.uncertified, S.judge.map, I.analyze.certify, I.analyze.certify-error | seat1 S1-08, seat3 S3-04 |
| G2 | root | Property | Traceability: every number in a Finding is a Report field verbatim, a Circulate value, or a tick produced by Quantize from one; rankings are complete (no truncation); no f64 arithmetic happens outside the core, Circulate and Quantize. | S.attribute.projection, S.quantize.only-crossing, I.analyze.attribute | seat3 S3-11 |
| G3 | root | Property | Determinism: equal (spec, CorePolicy, Boundary) bytes under a pinned thread count give equal verdicts, findings and receipts (excluding the timestamp). Report bytes may differ in the last digits of spectral fields across thread counts, which is why the count is pinned and bound. | S.analyze.thread-pin, S.analyze.determinism, S.join.monoid, A.circulate.forest, S.bind.binding | seat1 S1-04 (RAYON_NUM_THREADS 1/2/8 gave three report md5s) |
| G4 | root | Property | Gauge invariance: on the Circulate domain (scalar or square-invertible maps), the loop verdict is unchanged by adding any exact cochain delta-p to w, provided the run stays certified and the policy floor is still cleared after the shift. Consequence: no verdict reads harmonic SHARE (Spec v1 L5-L7 retracted; E2a arbitrage at share 2e-5). | A.circulate.exact-zero, A.circulate.linear, A.classify.circ-only, S.circulate.domain, S.quantize.floor | E2a, seat1 S1-02, S1-15 |
| G5 | root | Property | Clean-twin completeness: x a global section (x-mode) or w = delta p (w-mode) is reported consistent / HOLDS. In w-mode node discord is NotApplicable (an exact w is consistent pairwise evidence, not a node error), so only circulations can fire. | G4, A.quantize.disc-source, S.quantize.floor, S.analyze.x-only-exact | seat1 S1-01 (w = delta p ranked nodes by |w|^2) |
| G6 | root | Differential | Compositionality (parallel associativity): the receipt of a multi-component spec equals the join of the receipts of its components analysed separately; findings partition by component. HOLE until S.analyze.hodge-local is shown: batching can mask a small component's loop under the core's |w|^2-relative row filter. | S.analyze.component-local, S.analyze.hodge-local, S.join.monoid, S.join.cover, I.judge.join | seat1 S1-07 (d_batch_mask vs d_tri_alone) |
| G7 | root | Types | Tier honesty: 'proved' is attached only to Formal laws whose Bend proof and --verdict checked; numeric fields are worded 'certified residual'; approximate layers never write exact fields (ADR-008, ADR-013). | S.bind.tier, S.explain.wording | seat2 S2-12 |
| G8 | root | Property | Surface equivalence: for the same (Corpus, policies, Boundary) the CLI, the MCP tool and the HTTP handler return byte-identical Findings; a transport only wraps. | S.surface.envelope, S.explain.pure, G3 | seat3 S3-09 |
| G9 | root | Differential | Able to fail: every blocking oracle kills its planted mutants at Touchstone layers 0 (Bend), 1 (Haskell), 2 (Rust), 3 (interface) and 4 (verifier, planted-bug corpus with a hidden holdout). HOLE until layers 3 and 4 exist. | V.mut.L0, V.mut.L1, V.mut.L2, V.mut.L3, V.mut.L4 | seat2 S2-05 |
| G10 | root | Property | Separation of duties: laws are signed by a human before they gate anything; verifier-owned paths (laws, tests, golden tables, gates) are not writable by builder agents; verdicts come from a different model family than the builder. HOLE: all three are unbuilt today. | V.sep.signed, V.sep.fence, V.sep.family | seat2 S2-01, S2-03, S2-17 |
| G11 | root | Types | Language and ship path: no Python on any gate, oracle or receipt path; shipped verdict code is the Rust transcription, never Bend-compiled output (a Bend proof never approves code alone). | V.lang.no-python, V.lang.ship-rust | seat2 S2-13 |

## L1 Stage and interface

| id | where | tier | law | derives from | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| S.ingest.total-or-reject | Ingest | Types | An unknown status, kind or endpoint, or a self-loop, yields Rejected(reason) (exit 3), never a default value. |  | specv1 memory_audit exit 3 |
| S.ingest.ids-stable | Ingest | Formal | Entity ids are the note slug or (system, key): equal corpora give equal ids, so Diff can match across runs. |  | ingest_ids_stable |
| S.encode.valid | Encode | Formal | Encode is valid by construction: for every well-formed domain graph the spec passes Validate (endpoints exist, u != v, map shapes de x dim, identity only when dims agree, finite entries <= 1e75). | A.encode.endpoints, A.encode.shapes | encode_valid |
| S.encode.index | Encode | Formal | Encode fixes an order-preserving bijection between domain relations and spec edges; Attribute and Explain use its inverse. |  | encode_index_bij |
| S.encode.mode | Encode | Formal | Mode honesty: w is sent iff every relation has an observation; a partial observation set is rejected. |  | encode_mode |
| S.encode.one-cochain | Encode | Types | Exactly one of x, w is sent; both is rejected (the core silently prefers w, v1.rs:238). |  | seat1 S1-18 |
| S.validate.mirror | Validate | Differential | The products-side validator accepts exactly what the core parser accepts, on generated and mutated specs. |  | v1_rejects_bad_specs, check_edges_refuses_each_bad_edge |
| S.analyze.outcome | Analyze | Types | A core run yields exactly one of Report or CoreError{exit 1|2|signal|timeout, stderr}; a CoreError is never coerced into a Report; the P_INPUT_01 text is kept byte for byte. |  | seat3 S3-04 |
| S.analyze.complex | Analyze | CoreCited | delta delta = 0; a twisted map on a filled face is rejected as not a complex. |  | d_squared_is_zero, twisted_map_on_filled_face_is_rejected_as_not_a_complex |
| S.analyze.hodge | Analyze | CoreCited | Hodge split: exact and harmonic parts are orthogonal and sum to w; well defined for any map shape. |  | hodge_components_orthogonal_and_sum |
| S.analyze.x-only-exact | Analyze | CoreCited | With node data only, w := delta x is exact: harmonic share is zero. |  | v1_x_only_is_exact_and_rotation_loop_kills_h0 |
| S.analyze.holonomy | Analyze | CoreCited | Holonomy around an unfilled loop removes global sections; K4 keeps its loop space. |  | holonomy_kills_h0_and_k4_keeps_loop_space |
| S.analyze.component-local | Analyze | CoreCited | H0 cut and spectra are per connected component (L0 block diagonal). |  | v1_multi_component_h0_matches_dense_count, v1_two_scale_components_use_local_zero_cut |
| S.analyze.hodge-local | Analyze | Differential | Per-edge harmonic energies of a multi-component spec equal those of each component analysed alone up to the certified residual, and no row a policy-visible tolerance would count is dropped by the |w|^2-relative filter or by top. OPEN: the Hodge CG is a global solve with a global stop rule. |  | seat1 S1-07 |
| S.analyze.determinism | Analyze | CoreCited | Two runs of the v1 path in one process give an identical report (same threads). |  | v1_triangle_harmonic_share_is_one_third_and_report_is_deterministic |
| S.analyze.thread-pin | Analyze | Types | The products always run the core with RAYON_NUM_THREADS pinned (default 1) and record the count in CorePolicy. |  | seat1 S1-04 |
| S.analyze.top-complete | Analyze | Types | The core is always invoked with top >= |V| + |E| of the spec, so every ranking is complete; a truncated ranking is BLOCKED(incomplete). |  | seat3 S3-11 |
| S.analyze.extension-pins | Analyze | Differential | Pinned boundary values come back equal after the report's 12-significant-digit rounding; products compare sig(pin), never the raw pin. |  | seat1 S1-05 |
| S.analyze.extension-unique | Analyze | CoreCited | unique iff dim H0(X,B;F) = 0 under the run's H0 policy; an unpinned component is reported not unique; an empty boundary equals plain H0. |  | unpinned_component_is_reported_not_unique_and_bad_boundary_rejected, empty_boundary_equals_absolute_h0_on_the_catalogue |
| S.analyze.extension-minimal | Analyze | CoreCited | The extension minimises energy with the boundary fixed; when not unique the values are the minimum-norm minimiser. |  | extension_minimises_energy, path_extension_is_linear_and_unique, no_boundary_reduces_to_h0_projection |
| S.certify.wf | Certify | Property | Report well-formedness: h1 = dim_C1 + h0 - dim_C0 (graphs); if norm2 > 0 then |exact_share + harmonic_share - 1| <= 2 cert_coclosed + 1e-11, else both shares are 0 and w-mode evidence is NotApplicable; unique = (h0_relative == 0) when present. Any violation is BLOCKED(report). |  | rank_nullity_and_euler, seat1 S1-13 |
| S.certify.policy | Certify | Types | Cert carries zero_policy, zero_rule and h0_absolute_tol; verdicts are never compared across runs with different policies. |  | seat1 S1-08 |
| S.circulate.domain | Circulate | Types | Circulate is defined only when every edge map is a scalar or a square invertible matrix on uniform stalks (de = dim u = dim v); otherwise it returns NotApplicable and the loop decision is single-oracle (core harmonic energy), recorded as such in the receipt. |  | seat1 S1-02 (a_tree_nonsurj, b_rate_triangle_exact, c_zero_map_edge) |
| S.circulate.exact | Circulate | Differential | On its domain, Circulate returns for each fundamental cycle of a fixed spanning forest the transported sum of w around it; exact for rational scalar rates. | A.circulate.exact-zero, A.circulate.linear, A.circulate.basis-size, A.circulate.forest |  |
| S.quantize.only-crossing | Quantize | Types | Quantize is the only place an f64 becomes discrete; Classify accepts comparison bits and Ticks<Unit> only, never f64. |  |  |
| S.quantize.threshold | Quantize | Types | Threshold faithfulness by construction: each comparison v >= tol is made once in f64 inside Quantize and carried as a Bool; ticks only carry magnitude. | A.quantize.compare-once, A.quantize.saturate | seat1 S1-12 |
| S.quantize.floor | Quantize | Property | Fail-before-freeze for policies: tol >= kappa * max(certified residuals, cert_coclosed * |w|, 1e-12 |v| (report rounding), 1e-24 |w|^2 for energies (row filter), ulp); otherwise BLOCKED(policy). |  | seat1 S1-03, S1-12 |
| S.quantize.nonfinite | Quantize | Property | NaN, inf and null report values quantise to BLOCKED, never to 0. |  |  |
| S.classify.total | Classify | Types | Classify is a total, terminating function to a closed verdict enum (Bend totality checker + Rust closed enum). | A.classify.uncertified, A.classify.undetermined, A.classify.xonly, A.classify.mono, A.classify.circ-only, A.classify.loop-iff, A.classify.disc-iff, A.classify.consistent-iff, A.classify.h0-policy | seat1 S1-16 |
| S.attribute.projection | Attribute | Property | Attribute only projects: Finding numbers are built through FromReport<T> / FromCirc<T> constructors; there is no public constructor from f64. | A.attribute.loop-blame, A.attribute.fixable, A.attribute.fill, A.attribute.x-only, A.attribute.context-only, A.attribute.ranking |  |
| S.judge.map | Judge | Formal | Verdict map: consistent -> HOLDS (and only consistent); fixable, loop or map-conflict -> BROKEN; inconclusive or underdetermined -> BLOCKED; two oracles disagreeing -> HOLE. Never averaged. |  | receipt_map_hole, receipt_map_uncertified, holds_iff_consistent |
| S.join.monoid | Join | Formal | Join is a bounded join-semilattice on HOLDS < BROKEN < BLOCKED < HOLE: associative, commutative, idempotent, HOLDS the unit, HOLE absorbing. |  | join_assoc, join_comm, join_idem, join_unit_l, join_unit_r, join_hole_absorbs |
| S.join.cover | Join | Formal | A system verdict is a join over a declared cover; a missing component contributes HOLE (a child can never claim system-level HOLDS). |  | join_cover_missing_is_hole |
| S.join.is-max | Join | Property | join(a, b) = max(a, b) in the order HOLDS < BROKEN < BLOCKED < HOLE. |  | join_is_max |
| S.join.no-drop | Join | Types | The system receipt lists every non-HOLDS component verdict with its finding or question; joining never discards a BROKEN under a HOLE. |  | seat2 S2-14 |
| S.bind.binding | Bind | Property | A receipt binds sha256 of the core manifest, laws.lock, spec bytes, outcome bytes, CorePolicy (incl. thread count), DomainPolicy and finding; changing any one changes the receipt hash. |  | seat1 S1-04, seat3 S3-12 |
| S.bind.tier | Bind | Types | Receipt.tier is an enum; proved() is Some only for Tier::Formal with a non-null, checked proof hash. |  | seat2 S2-12 |
| S.bind.manifest | Bind | Types | Bind refuses unless the G0 manifest check passed in this run; the manifest covers the core only (laws are frozen separately in laws.lock). |  | seat2 S2-01, seat3 S3-18 |
| S.explain.pure | Explain | Types | An Explanation is a function of the Finding alone: no Report access, no model call. |  | seat3 S3-02 |
| S.explain.wording | Explain | Types | Every Explanation carries 'certified residual, not a proof that any fact is true' verbatim and never the word 'proved' for a numeric result. |  | seat3 S3-02 |
| S.diff.keyed | Diff | Formal | Findings are matched by entity / edge id (stable Ingest ids), never by rank position. |  | diff_keyed |
| S.diff.partition | Diff | Formal | Every entry of either Finding lands in exactly one of {new, resolved, unchanged, drifted}. |  | diff_partition |
| S.diff.reflexive | Diff | Formal | Diff(f, f) is empty. |  | diff_reflexive |
| S.diff.exit | Diff | Types | Exit code 2 iff new is non-empty; 3 on Rejected; 0 otherwise (the --baseline CI gate). |  | specv1 memory_audit --baseline |
| S.fill.determined-only | Fill | Formal | A domain value changes only if its fill is marked determined (extension unique). |  | fill_determined |
| S.fill.ask | Fill | Types | When any fill is not determined the output is Ask(free_entities), not a graph. |  | seat3 S3-05 |
| S.fill.idempotent | Fill | Property | Re-running the pipeline on written-back data makes no further change: the remaining flags are irreducible. |  | specv1 memory_audit step 3 |
| S.surface.envelope | root | Types | Transports (CLI, MCP stdio, HTTP) wrap a Finding in an envelope and never alter it. |  | seat3 S3-09 |
| V.mut.L0 | root | Differential | Bend layer: every planted mutant of the atoms makes at least one closed law fail to check (judged per law id, never by text diff). |  | products/gates/atom_gate.sh step 7 |
| V.mut.L1 | root | Differential | Haskell layer: the same mutants applied to Laws.hs each make a law BROKEN. |  | products/gates/atom_gate.sh step 7b |
| V.mut.L2 | root | Differential | Rust layer: cargo-mutants plus constructor-swap mutants are each killed by a law test (not only by the golden table). |  | products/kit/receipts |
| V.mut.L3 | root | Differential | Interface layer: mutating interface.lock (swap unit types, reorder fields, flip defaults) breaks a build or a consumer test. |  | seat2 S2-05 |
| V.mut.L4 | root | Differential | Verifier layer: a planted-bug corpus kept outside the repo by hash, re-planted weekly, with a hidden holdout scored separately. |  | seat2 S2-05 |
| V.sep.signed | root | Types | A law id enters laws.lock only with a human signed_by and a checker receipt (HOLDS or BROKEN, never UNCHECKED). |  | seat2 S2-01, S2-03 |
| V.sep.fence | root | Types | A hook denies builder writes to products/bend/LAWS.bend, laws.lock, kit/tests, kit/bridge*, haskell/, gates/. |  | seat2 S2-03 |
| V.sep.family | root | Property | At least one verifying seat per review round is from a different model family than the builder (today: all Claude). |  | seat2 S2-17 |
| V.lang.no-python | root | Types | No .py file under products/{laws,kit,haskell,bend,gates} and no python invocation in any gate script (checked by a test). |  | tests/ontology.rs no_python_on_the_gate_path |
| V.lang.ship-rust | root | Types | The shipped classifier, judge and join are sheaf-kit (Rust); Bend output is never linked into a product. |  | seat2 S2-13 |
| I.ingest.encode | Ingest → Encode | Differential | The Rust ingester and the reference adapter emit byte-identical DomainGraphs on the fixture set. |  | seat3 S3-06, C40 |
| I.encode.validate | Encode → Validate | Differential | Every encoder output is accepted by the core binary (exit 0) on fixtures and generated domain graphs. | S.encode.valid, S.validate.mirror |  |
| I.validate.analyze | Validate → Analyze | Types | Analyze receives exactly the bytes Validate accepted, plus CorePolicy and Boundary as separate typed inputs. |  | seat3 S3-10 |
| I.validate.circulate | Validate → Circulate | Types | Circulate's edge list is ValidSpec's, in spec index order. |  | seat3 S3-10 |
| I.analyze.pin | Analyze → Certify | Types | The report binding is generated from report.rs at the pinned commit; a missing or renamed field fails to parse and yields BLOCKED(report-schema). |  |  |
| I.analyze.certify | Analyze → Certify | Types | Certify reads only certificate fields and copies them unchanged. | I.analyze.pin |  |

| I.quantize.classify | Quantize → Classify | Types | Evidence and tolerance share one unit: Ticks<Loop> and Ticks<Disc> do not mix. |  |  |
| I.analyze.attribute | Analyze → Attribute | Types | Attribute reads only the complete rankings and extension values (S.analyze.top-complete holds). |  | seat3 S3-11 |

## L2 Atom

| id | where | tier | law | derives from | evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A.encode.endpoints | Encode | Formal | Every encoded edge has u < n, v < n and u != v. |  | encode_ends_ok |
| A.encode.shapes | Encode | Formal | Every encoded map has de rows and dim(endpoint) columns; omitted maps only when dims agree. |  | encode_shapes_ok |
| A.certify.converged | Certify | Types | spectral.converged AND hodge.converged AND (no boundary OR extension.converged). |  | seat3 S3-16 |
| A.certify.cut | Certify | Types | cut_consistent_with_zero_tol AND NOT near_zero_ambiguous. |  | seat3 S3-16 |
| A.certify.unique-null | Certify | Types | unique = null or lower_bound_only = true -> not certified, reason NotComputed; never read as unique = true (three-valued Bounded | Free | Unknown). |  | seat1 S1-08, seat3 S3-07 |
| A.circulate.exact-zero | Circulate | Formal | Telescoping with maps: for scalar rational rates (num, den), the transported circulation of delta p around any cycle is zero (over Nat: product-scaled heads equal product-scaled tails). |  | circ_exact_zero |
| A.circulate.linear | Circulate | Formal | circ(w1 + w2) = circ(w1) + circ(w2) on every cycle (signed values as Bool + Nat pairs). |  | circ_linear |
| A.circulate.basis-size | Circulate | Differential | The fundamental cycle count |E| - |V| + #components equals the core's h1 only for the constant R^1 sheaf with identity maps; otherwise no relation is claimed. |  | seat1 S1-06 |
| A.circulate.forest | Circulate | Formal | The spanning forest is BFS in spec edge order from the lowest node index, so the cycle basis is a function of the spec bytes. |  | forest_deterministic |
| A.quantize.compare-once | Quantize | Types | The only f64 comparisons are v >= tol inside Quantize; Classify reads the resulting Bool. |  | seat1 S1-12 |
| A.quantize.saturate | Quantize | Formal | Ticks saturate at 2^53; a saturated tick never changes a comparison bit. |  | ticks_saturate |
| A.quantize.disc-source | Quantize | Types | In x-mode disc is the incident discord of delta x; in w-mode disc is NotApplicable (an exact w is consistent evidence) and only circulations can fire. |  | seat1 S1-01 |
| A.classify.uncertified | Classify | Formal | Not certified -> inconclusive, whatever the evidence. |  | sound_uncertified |
| A.classify.undetermined | Classify | Formal | Certified, boundary given, not unique -> underdetermined. |  | undetermined |
| A.classify.xonly | Classify | Formal | x-only evidence never yields a loop conflict. |  | xonly_no_loop |
| A.classify.mono | Classify | Formal | Raising the loop tolerance never turns consistent into loop conflict (a theorem needing a Nat.is_ge monotonicity lemma; in OPEN.bend until proved). |  | mono_tolerance |
| A.classify.circ-only | Classify | Formal | The loop decision reads only whether the max circulation clears its tolerance. |  | circ_only |
| A.classify.loop-iff | Classify | Formal | Certified and bounded: LoopConflict exactly when the input is not x-only and the max circulation clears its tolerance. |  | loop_iff_circ |
| A.classify.disc-iff | Classify | Formal | Certified and bounded: FixableNodes exactly when discord clears its tolerance and no loop fires (added after mutation testing). |  | fixable_iff_disc |
| A.classify.consistent-iff | Classify | Formal | Certified and bounded: Consistent exactly when no loop fires and discord is below tolerance (seat 2: the Consistent branch was unpinned). |  | consistent_iff |
| A.classify.h0-policy | Classify | Formal | Certified and h0 < h0_expected -> MapConflict (the maps themselves admit no section), which outranks fixable and is never reported as a node error (seat 1: E3c twisted frames read HOLDS). |  | h0_map_conflict |
| A.attribute.loop-blame | Attribute | Types | A loop finding names a cycle (two or more edges, closed walk), never a single edge as the cause. |  |  |
| A.attribute.fixable | Attribute | Formal | The fixable set equals {v : incident-discord ticks >= tolerance} over all nodes (complete rankings). |  | fixable_above_tol |
| A.attribute.ranking | Attribute | Property | Fixable nodes are listed by incident discord descending, ties by entity id. |  | seat3 C20 |
| A.attribute.fill | Attribute | Formal | A fill is marked determined only when the extension is certified unique. |  | fill_determined |
| A.attribute.x-only | Attribute | Types | For x-only input the loops field is NotApplicable, never an empty list. |  |  |
| A.attribute.context-only | Attribute | Types | Finding.context (h0, h1, harmonic_share, nulls) has no reader inside the pipeline; Explain may render it. |  | seat3 S3-13 |
| A.explain.loop-blame | Explain | Formal | For a loop entry the text names at least two edges and no single edge as the cause (L-WORD-1). |  | explain_loop_blame |
| A.explain.resolve | Explain | Property | what_would_resolve names the node for a fixable entry and the cycle edges for a loop entry. |  | seat3 S3-02 |

## How each layer becomes code (Touchstone atom pipeline)

| layer | proved in | enforced in | shipped in | gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L0 Global | composition of L1 (derivations above) | weakest-link tier check (tests/ontology.rs) | receipts + join (sheaf-kit) | every step below |
| L1 Stage / interface | Bend LAWS.bend (Formal leaves) | Haskell Laws.hs, same ids | one Rust module per stage | bridge tables A, A', B |
| L2 Atom | Bend PROOF.bend (+ --verdict) | Haskell, exhaustive small domain | Rust fn + same-id test | mutation L0 (Bend), L2 (cargo-mutants) |
| L3 Product | Bend instance of its parent atom | Haskell | per-product crate | product fixtures + differential vs core binary |

## Status: holes (open questions or known violations; they propagate to every law derived from them)

| id | layer | law |
|---|---|---|
| G6 | Global | Compositionality (parallel associativity): the receipt of a multi-component spec equals the join of the receipts of its components analysed separately; findings partition by component. HOLE until S.analyze.hodge-local is shown: batching can mask a small component's loop under the core's |w|^2-relative row filter. |
| G9 | Global | Able to fail: every blocking oracle kills its planted mutants at Touchstone layers 0 (Bend), 1 (Haskell), 2 (Rust), 3 (interface) and 4 (verifier, planted-bug corpus with a hidden holdout). HOLE until layers 3 and 4 exist. |
| G10 | Global | Separation of duties: laws are signed by a human before they gate anything; verifier-owned paths (laws, tests, golden tables, gates) are not writable by builder agents; verdicts come from a different model family than the builder. HOLE: all three are unbuilt today. |
| S.analyze.hodge-local | Stage | Per-edge harmonic energies of a multi-component spec equal those of each component analysed alone up to the certified residual, and no row a policy-visible tolerance would count is dropped by the |w|^2-relative filter or by top. OPEN: the Hodge CG is a global solve with a global stop rule. |
| V.mut.L3 | Stage | Interface layer: mutating interface.lock (swap unit types, reorder fields, flip defaults) breaks a build or a consumer test. |
| V.mut.L4 | Stage | Verifier layer: a planted-bug corpus kept outside the repo by hash, re-planted weekly, with a hidden holdout scored separately. |
| V.sep.signed | Stage | A law id enters laws.lock only with a human signed_by and a checker receipt (HOLDS or BROKEN, never UNCHECKED). |
| V.sep.fence | Stage | A hook denies builder writes to products/bend/LAWS.bend, laws.lock, kit/tests, kit/bridge*, haskell/, gates/. |
| V.sep.family | Stage | At least one verifying seat per review round is from a different model family than the builder (today: all Claude). |
